subject: Juniper Systems - CAIQ observability matrix & attestation (edge runtime telemetry)
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@juniper-systems.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Yuan <oliver.yuan@juniper-systems.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ - edge runtime telemetry scope and evidence ask

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this on — Juniper is moving into a pilot of your Private deployment in our edge zones and our audit team has a CAIQ follow-up focused specifically on runtime observability, telemetry retention, and zone-level attestations. The auditor has flagged a few areas where they need explicit CAIQ mappings and samples: 

- Control mapping for "Runtime and Telemetry" items (dataflow diagrams + which control IDs map to the telemetry proofs)
- Sample runtime logs showing prefix/KV cache hits and per-request routing decisions (redact PII)
- Documentation for model routing/fallback policies and how fallbacks are recorded in logs
- Evidence of KMS/HSM rotation and access logs for key operations in edge buckets
- Retention and deletion proof for telemetry (we need a retention trace for 90/180/365 day windows)

Can you confirm what owners you can surface for each artifact and whether you can provide a 2-week turnaround? If possible, we also want a short matrix (spreadsheet) mapping CAIQ control IDs to Redwood artifacts and an owner column.

Thanks — this will be part of our CSA package.

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Cloud Security, Juniper Systems

(Attachment: juniper_caiq_questions_v2.xlsx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@juniper-systems.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ - edge runtime telemetry scope and evidence ask

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can definitely produce a CAIQ crosswalk focused on runtime observability and provide sampled artifacts. Proposed plan: 

1) Kimberly will own the artifacts collection (logs, retention traces, KMS evidence).
2) Priyom will lead the CAIQ control-to-artifact mapping and populate the spreadsheet with control IDs + evidence pointer + owner.
3) I will own the exec attestation language and coordinate any redaction/DocuSign steps.

Timeline: initial draft of the spreadsheet + a small bundle of redacted runtime logs by 2028-06-08 (one week). Full evidence package and attestation template by 2028-06-15 (two weeks). If Juniper needs a tighter window we can prioritize specific controls.

I uploaded a working sheet to a shared Drive folder and added a JIRA for tracking. Please grant access to anyone on your side who needs it.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3JuniperCAIQ
JIRA: SEC-4821

Action items assigned: 
- Kimberly: gather runtime logs (edge regions list, prefix/KV cache samples, routing decision traces) — deliver initial bundle 06/08
- Priyom: populate CAIQ sheet with control mapping (A1.1 -> runtime-logging-artifact) — deliver 06/08
- Marcus: prepare attestation template and coordinate legal as needed — deliver 06/15

Cc'ing Oliver to keep dev/security in the loop.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-attestation-template.pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@juniper-systems.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ - edge runtime telemetry scope and evidence ask

Elena / team — quick status update from artifact collection: 

- I attached the working CAIQ matrix (juniper_caiq_matrix.xlsx) in the Drive folder and a small tarball with sample logs (runtime-telemetry-sample-logs.tar.gz). The logs are pre-redaction but have a README explaining what was redacted.
- What you'll find in the bundle: sample request traces showing routing decisions, KV cache hit/miss counters per-request, and a short prefix-cache timeline that demonstrates cold vs warm-cache behavior.
- KMS evidence: I can provide key rotation entries (audit log snippets) and the HSM operation audit summary; however the raw key material is never exported — I'll include the signed rotation records and the access-control audit.

Clarification needed: when you say "edge zones" do you need separate attestations per zone (e.g., us-west-edge-1 vs us-east-edge-2) or is a region-level attestation sufficient? The sample I uploaded is from the us-west-edge cluster — if you need per-zone evidence we will coordinate additional pulls which may add a few days.

Also noted: retention proof will include our retention-policy yaml exports and an automated retention job run history for the last 12 months. If Juniper's auditor wants a signed timestamp on deletion events we can generate a signed manifest.

I flagged a few control IDs in the sheet where we still need instrumentation clarifications from the runtime team — Priyom is triaging those.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
(Attachments referenced: juniper_caiq_matrix.xlsx, runtime-telemetry-sample-logs.tar.gz)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@juniper-systems.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Jun 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ - edge runtime telemetry scope and evidence ask

Thanks Marcus and Kimberly — this looks good.

A few quick confirmations: 
- Per-zone attestations: Juniper's compliance team will accept region-level attestation for the pilot but will ask for per-zone evidence in production. Region-level is fine for now.
- The sample logs and the README are sufficient for the auditor's initial review; we may request one extra redaction pass but that's normal.
- We do require a signed deletion manifest for retention evidence (if you can attach the signed manifest to the final bundle that will speed closure).

Next steps: Oliver and I will review the Drive bundle today and open SEC-4821 with any follow-ups. Once your attestation template is finalized we'll send a DocuSign for the privacy addendum.

Can you indicate whether the signed manifest can be produced by 06/14? If so we'll mark the ticket with a target closure of 06/20.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Cloud Security, Juniper Systems

(Next: DocuSign link will be requested; please expect a request from legal@juniper-systems.com)

--END--
